note: Rejudged after TestClientRetransmit (rfc2865_client_test.go) was strengthened to capture the raw bytes of attempt 1 and attempt 2 and assert both Identifier (byte 1) and all 16 Request Authenticator octets (bytes 4..20) remain identical across retransmission (no longer a floor assertion). Re-read RFC 2865 Section 2.5 ('If the NAS is retransmitting a RADIUS request to the same server as before, and the attributes haven't changed, you MUST use the same Request Authenticator, ID, and source port.'). TestRFC2865RetransmitRepeatsIdentifierAuthenticatorAndSourcePort (rfc2865_wire_rules_test.go) is unchanged and additionally byte-compares Identifier, all 16 Request Authenticator octets, attributes and UDP source addr:port across attempts; TestAccessRequestRetransmitIsByteIdentical guards full-packet equality including User-Name and User-Password. {single-polarity: positive} holds because Exchange resends the identical pre-encoded buffer over the same UDP socket.
